thought: He's been blind since birth. He's also saved lives from drowning, 13 times over.
support: Bhullu Sahni, from Dumduma village in Bihar's Samastipur district, has been visually impaired since birth. Despite being unable to see on land, he is an expert swimmer, taught by his father Kailu Sahni, who also taught him fishing as a child. He is widely reported to have saved 13 people from drowning in local rivers and ponds over the years, diving in to rescue them by feel and sound alone. Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar publicly honored him with an award recognizing his rescue efforts, and he is locally known as the 'Jal Yoddha' - the Water Warrior.
